name: RetireX Online
description:
RETIREX ONLINE

Drift through corners. Boost down the straight. Race inside Minecraft.

RetireX Online is a custom kart racing server for Minecraft Bedrock Edition. Pick your kart, learn the racing line and compete with friends across city streets, forest trails and purpose-built circuits. Custom models, racing controls, sound effects and a dedicated racing HUD bring the action to life.

Server address: cybox.kr

Port: 19132

Edition: Minecraft Bedrock — Windows, Android, iPhone and iPad

CHOOSE YOUR GAME

Speed Race

Master drifting, manage your boost and find the fastest route. Race individually or team up with friends. Explore shortcuts, boost pads and jumps on tracks that feature them.

Item Race

Race individually or in teams while collecting items to attack, defend and turn the tables. Item combinations and position-based item chances add another layer of strategy to every lap.

Kart Soccer

An eight-participant minigame with a twist: three red-team racers, three blue-team racers, a player-controlled football and a neutral referee. Use your kart to hit the ball, collect items and score goals. The team with the most goals after ten minutes wins. AI participants can fill open places.

Practice, Time Attack and Tutorials

Learn the controls with PC and mobile tutorials, practise your driving and challenge your best times. Race records, leaderboards and ghost runs give you new goals to work towards.

MORE THAN A STANDARD MINECRAFT MINIGAME

- A collection of custom-designed karts and a dedicated garage.

- Multiplayer racing with AI racers available to fill open places.

- Solo and team racing, plus kart soccer.

- Controls and interface features designed for both PC and mobile players.

- Custom tracks with different environments, corners and racing challenges.

- Server resource packs delivered when you join.

PLAY IN YOUR LANGUAGE
